chunks: And Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Ribʿī ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the testimony of a woman who was present when a man was making a will, and there was no man with her, he عليه السلام said: “Her testimony is accepted for one-fourth of the bequest.”

key_terms.رُبُعِ الْوَصِيَّةِ: one-fourth of the bequest that is legally upheld
key_terms.شَهَادَةِ امْرَأَةٍ: the testimony of a woman in a legal matter

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the testimony of a single woman in a bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on testimony concerning a bequest when only one woman is present. It states that her testimony is accepted with effect for one-fourth of the will, making it a concise ruling in the law of bequests and evidence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5435 - Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Ribʿi ibn Abdullah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

regarding the testimony of a woman who was present when a man was making a will, and there was no man with her.
Imam (as) said: "Her testimony is accepted for one-fourth of the will."
